title: Seabird Nesting (14097767700).jpg
author: USFWS Pacific Southwest Region
description: The Farallon Islands are an important reserve protecting a huge seabird colony. The islands' position in the highly productive California Current and Eastern Pacific upwelling region, as well as the absence of other large islands that would provide suitable nesting grounds, result in a seabird population often numbering 250,000.
